newsitem.title: FRANCE: France pleased by conduct of Albanian election.
newsitem.headline: France pleased by conduct of Albanian election.

text.p: France on Monday expressed satisfaction at voter turnout and the absence of widespread violence during the first round of Albania's parliamentary elections.

"We are pleased with the high voter turnout in Albanian elections and hope it will remain high in the second round next Sunday," Foreign Ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt told a daily news briefing. "This first round took place without any major incidents, including in the south."
"This vote is an essential step in the national reconciliation process. It should be followed up by the establishment of institutions needed for the country to function," Rummelhardt said.
Officials estimated that more than 60 percent of the electorate had voted in Sunday's election.

Isolated incidents across the country claimed at least one life when an electoral official was shot dead near the southern town of Fier. But the election was otherwise free of the violence that has plagued Albania in recent months.
